description: This file defines a static utility class 'SegmentBuilder' for encoding and decoding data into an ArraySegment<byte>, including methods for calculating sizes, appending bytes and strings, and reading bytes and strings from segments.

classes.name: SegmentBuilder
classes.description: A static utility class for encoding data into and decoding data from ArraySegment<byte> buffers.

methods.name: CalculateAppendSize(ReadOnlySpan<byte> memory)
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to append a byte span, including space for length.

methods.name: CalculateAppendSize(string str)
methods.description: Calculates the size needed to append a string, including space for length; handles null strings.

methods.name: Append(ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int writerOffset, ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes)
methods.description: Appends a byte span to the segment at the specified offset, updating the offset.

methods.name: Append(ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int writerOffset, string str)
methods.description: Appends a string to the segment, handling null strings by writing -1.

methods.name: ReadNextBytes(ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int readerOffset)
methods.description: Reads the next byte array segment from the buffer, updating the reader offset.

methods.name: ReadNextString(ArraySegment<byte> segment, ref int readerOffset)
methods.description: Reads the next string from the buffer, handling null and empty strings.
